tasks.title: impl: ScriptedTool gains applied and a dispatch stage; next program schema version
tasks.criteria: ScriptedTool gains applied and a before/after stage; ToolFailed gains the stage. The stage travels in the served outcome payload; applied never does. ExecutionProgram carries a world-truth field (ordinals of applied faults) encoded as a version-gated required header line holding an explicit, possibly empty list, added through required_header_tags_at for the new version only. Legacy versions decode with the list empty and every stage after dispatch. Structural rejections (line missing at the new version, ordinal not a tool interaction) run in the persistence/validator layer; stage-dependent ones (ordinal whose outcome is completed or before dispatch; applied on a before-dispatch fault) run in dst_replay.world_state_of, so dst_program.ail imports no port code. Journal programs carry the empty list; the seam stages are ruled (unrecorded before dispatch, cardinality after). A frozen fixture of the new version holds one applied and one non-applied fault. Acceptance rows (c) each rejection, (d) legacy specimens decode as before, (e) stage codec round trip, (f) legacy fault decodes after dispatch. make check_core, the program pin test, and ailang check on every file outside src/core/*.ail naming ScriptedTool, ExecutionProgram, WorldState or ToolFailed pass.
tasks.note: Precedent ba272abc (/1 to /2, 21 files). S30 and S32 govern the applied default; the stage default is conservative, not S32. Review 2, findings 3, 4, 13, 14, 16.

tasks.title: impl: the world effect log, and ToolFailed's stage
tasks.criteria: WorldState has an append-only effect log of {ordinal, call_id, effect_key}, the ordinal recorded at append; only world_tool's scripted arm appends, for every completed call and every applied fault. scripted_tool_outcome reads neither applied nor the log. World truth never enters the extension token: ext_world's encoder writes neither applied nor the log, and after adoption at tool_phase.ail:437 both are re-seated from the pre-hook world, applied matched by tool_call_id. Every builder W1.1 lists fills the program's world-truth list from the log's fault entries; world_state_of sets applied from it and replay rebuilds the log from completed outcomes and listed faults. Acceptance: (a) the frozen fixture round-trips and replay reproduces the effect log against the listed ordinals; (b) two programs differing only in the list serve identical interactions, payload and advance; (g) ext_world round-trip rows: the token holds neither, and after an adopting hook the flags and log equal the pre-hook world's. make check_core and make world_state pass.
tasks.note: ADR D4: no carrier for applied, including the extension token. Review 2, findings 1 (blocking), 7, 13.
